rationale: Consultancy site with occasional SME/banking studies; thin and irregular output for A4 market statistics.

University site; thesis repository worth mining once for digital-payments research, not a recurring statistics feed.
Securities regulator republishes commissioned macro/analytical studies; legally clear standalone publications archive.

Single press article carrying Visa Pulse ME figures — valuable evidence, not a continuing source.
HBS section of MONSTAT; monitor the MONSTAT parent portal which already covers this release stream.
Low-transparency syndicated vendor report page; paywalled sizing claims of little analytical value.
Aggregator giving comparable ME bank-level market share and balance-sheet metrics for cross-checking.
Official ME e-procurement portal; ATM/POS/card/thermal-roll notices and awards are core demand signal.
Procurement policy body publishing annual aggregate procurement reports and authority lists; sizes the public-sector market.
Legacy procurement archive, openly searchable — essential historical baseline of pre-2020 ATM/POS awards.
Commercial alert service with unique appeals-decision database; URL check failed and access likely subscription-based.
Regional tender aggregator with ME feed; useful but alerts/full notices typically require registration.
CPV-code search isolates ATM/POS categories across ME; commercial access terms need clearing.
State postal operator's own procurement page — direct read on non-bank cash and counter/terminal infrastructure demand.
Largest ME utility biller; tenders for bill payment, POS/kiosk acceptance and cash collection are in-scope payments demand.
CBCG sub-page among 65 siblings; basic-account fee comparison is covered by monitoring the CBCG parent.
CBCG consumer-protection function page; complaint statistics valuable but arrive via the CBCG parent publication stream.
National vacancy register carries statutory bank/PSP postings naming card and ATM systems — durable weak-signal feed.
Sector-filtered ME banking job-ads feed with high signal density on payments and card-business hiring.
Main ME job board's IT section names concrete card/switch/core-banking technologies used by banks and vendors.
